newsitem.title: USA: Witnesses say two Army rape accusers wanted sex.
newsitem.headline: Witnesses say two Army rape accusers wanted sex.

text.p: Defence witnesses in the Army court martial of Staff Sgt. Delmar Simpson testified Monday that two of the six female trainees he is accused of raping had indicated a desire for sex with him.

One of the women was also described by the witnesses as a "compulsive liar." The other was described as a "rebellious" trainee who had repeated conflicts with Simpson, then vowed revenge on the African American sergeant after telling fellow trainees of being raped by him in a frequently-changed story.
Pvt. Carnesia Jones testified that one alleged victim, a white trainee from Pennsylvania, stated, "That black bastard is going to get exactly what he deserves."

Both alleged victims testified last week that Simpson had forced or pressured them into sex. Simpson has pleaded guilty to having consensual sex with them but has pleaded innocent to all 19 rape counts, involving six women, that he faces.

Simpson also is charged with 35 other counts including indecent exposure, battery and maltreatment. He has pleaded innocent to those charges but guilty to 11 counts of improper sexual intercourse with trainees and five of propositioning.

A ruling by court martial judge Col. Paul Johnston Friday signalled that the powerful authority a drill sergeant holds over a trainee could be grounds for a finding of rape even if the woman did not clearly resist a sexual encounter.

Defence attorneys, who have argued that all of Simpson's sexual relations were consensual, said they expected to complete their case by Tuesday. They said it had not been decided whether Simpson would testify.

Jones and Pvt. Divina Scott testified Monday that one of Simpson's alleged victims, a black Illinois woman, had told incredible and inconsistent stories about her past that gave her a reputation as a habitual liar.
The witnesses, who also had trained at the proving ground, said the woman had declared her interest in Simpson two or three times and was encouraged to pursue him to better her career.
"I was: 'You go girl, 'cause you can get promoted quicker,'" Scott said. She said the woman sought Simpson's attention by wearing revealing clothing and would enter his office wearing such clothes.
Later, Jones said, the trainee happily announced that she and Simpson "had a secret."

The Illinois woman said last week Simpson had treated her like "his pet, like his dog" and ordered her into his office restroom to remove her clothes, then had sex with her and told her to shut up as she cried.

Jones said the Pennsylvania woman had frequent run-ins with Simpson over issues such as her difficulty in meeting fitness standards and discipline and that "she hated him because she was very rebellious."

But the woman expressed an interest in Simpson even as he yelled at her during training, Jones said. "She told me that he had a sexy bald head ... if the chance were given to her she would have sex with Drill Sergeant Simpson," she said.

Jones said shortly after the Labour Day weekend in 1996 the Pennsylvania woman told her she had been raped by Simpson, but in retelling the incident several details changed such as the day and time of the attack and its manner.
In testimony last week, the woman said Simpson had threatened to kill her if she told on him.
